newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lewis & Peat obtains novel trade finance facility.
newsitem.headline: Lewis & Peat obtains novel trade finance facility.

text.p: Lewis & Peat (Rubber) Holdings Pte Ltd has obtained a US$150 million syndicated trade finance facility, the first of its kind in Singapore, arranger Rabobank, Singapore Branch said in a statement on Monday.

Rabobank will act as sole financier for the facility which is a hybrid combining trade financing and syndication. Other banks involved in the deal have been invited to participate only as risk participants and not to provide funds.
Rabobank said it will fund and control all future transactions for Lewis & Peat as well as finance its futures contracts.
The facility consists of short term advances, overdrafts, freight financing and letters of credit. It will be used by the borrower's three offices in Singapore, London and New York.
Lewis & Peat is 75 percent owned by Indonesia's PT Bakrie Sumatra Plantation.
